newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan ends lower against US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan ends lower against US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed down at 8.2928 on Thursday from Wednesday's 8.2924 against the U.S. dollar in Shanghai with heavy selling seen at the 8.2920 level, traders said.
The weighted average price on Wednesday was 8.2921.

The yuan opened little changed at 8.2925 and rose to hit an intraday high of 8.2920 in early trading. It then slipped to move around 8.2924 for the rest of the session, hitting a low of 8.2934. Trading was active with most business done at 8.2924.
Dealers said the yuan met strong resistance after the rises of the past two weeks.
"When the yuan failed to breached the 8.2920 level in early trading, more selling pushed it lower," one dealer said.

A second dealer said that despite the yuan's fall today, pro-yuan sentiment had not been greatly hurt. "Strong pro-yuan sentiment was not greatly affected despite today's fall and the yuan still has a chance to bounce up in the short term," he said.
Dealers said they expected the yuan to move in a range from 8.2920 to 8.2930 on Friday.
The yuan ended up at 7.2060 from 7.2600 against 100 Japanese yen and down at 1.0721 from 1.0712 vs the Hong Kong dollar.
